tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// phyogs kyi gtor ma bzhugs// ༄༅// de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtong ba'i phyir/ shar phyogs nas yul 'khor srung*/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yā d+ya the dan/ dhā ri ṇi/ dhā ri ṇi/ pra dhān+sa/ ni bhañdza ni/ pra bhañdza ni/ bi dha ma ni/ kiṃ pu ru ṣe/ sha ka le/ sā ra the/ shū la dhā ri ṇe/ shū la dha re/ shud+dha tsa ra ṇe/ gho ṣa ba te/ shā rā gre/ shān+ti/ che ge mo shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jigs rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya'o// s+yā d+ya the dan/ a khe/ na khe/ bi na khe/ ban+dhe/ ba ra ṇe/ tsa ba le ba khe/ ba kha ne/ a khi le/ na khi ne/ ba hu le bha ge bha gan+da le/ ba she ba sha ba ni swā hā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ lho phyogs nas 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yā d+ya the dan/ shān+ti/ shā ra ba ti/ kān+ti/ kā ra wa ti/ kiṃ ka si/ kīṅka ra ti/ kim+ba ti/ dhā ra ṇi/ bar+dha ni/ bhū mi dha ra ṇi/ hi ma ba ti/ dz+yo tish+tsa ra ṇe/ mā lā gri/ che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig

/che ge mo lho phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yā d+ya the dan/ kha kha kha me/ kha la ne/ kha lo me/ kha ra li/ kha ra li/ ka ra khe/ ka shi ni/ ka ra te/ ka le/ ka mā ni/ bi dha le/ bi dhe ya sha ba ti sha mi/ sha ma ni swā hā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'i ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas nub phyogs su mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yā d+ya the dan/ par+ṇi ba rā gre/ pa la ba ti/ ba li ni/ bi sha me/ bi ba shi sā ga re/ khā rī ka pi le/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ nā ra dza ni/ bi dhā ri ni/ balku ma ti/ a tsa li/ nub phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo nub phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis yang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yā d+ya the dan/ kra ga ye/ kra ga she kra ga se/ kru sha me/ kru ke kruk+kha me/ kru ge a ga le/ na ga le/ sa ma ga le/ ku hu me hu me/ a la ke ka la ke i ri mi re dhi re/ a ru ga ba ti swā hā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gi ming dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas byang phyogs su rnam thos kyi bu 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yā d+ye the dan/ kharge kharge/ kharga r+bhe/ bi tsak+ṣa ni/ tsakra rā dza ne/

tsan+d+re/ tsa pa le/ bhī ma par+pa te/ kha rā gre ku ṭi la ka rā gre/ e kāk+shi/ brka ba ti/ sā ram̐ ga ba ti/ tsi tra kān+ti/ che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo byang phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yā d+ya the dan/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ a re/ a ra ṇe/ ba le/ ma hā ba le/ dzaṃ bhe/ dza ṭi le/ a kha ne/ ma kha ne/ kha kha ne/ kha raṭ+ṭe/ ha ri piṅga le/ ti miṅgi le/ ti miṅgi le swā hā/ bdag gi sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i ming dang stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ s+yā d+ya the dan/ prah+me prah+ma gho ṣe/ prah+me swa re/ badz+re badz+ra gho ṣe/ badz+ra dha re/ te sā ri/ a tsa le/ a ra ṇe/ i sha ne/ a rā ṇi te/ shū re/ ba rā gra/ prā pa te/ sā ra ba te/ che ge mo phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og rnams su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang*/ steng dang 'og rnams su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/

de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yā d+ya the dan/ a sam̐ ge khad ga ba te/ ba la ba te/ ba la nir+gho ṣe/ shū re shū ra dha re/ badz+ra ga me/ badz+ra dha re/ s+t+wam+bhe/ dzam+bhe ḍi ḍha sā re/ bi ra dze/ bi gha se/ ba rā gra prā pa te/ a ra ṇe/ dharma yut+te/ de shi bi ghu ṣ+ṭe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang*/ stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phyogs phyogs su rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o// phyogs kyi gtor ma ste lnga pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
